offence_category.reason: Charge is murder under s.302 r/w s.149.

statutory_provisions.correct_value: IPC s.148; IPC s.302 r/w s.149
statutory_provisions.quote: Sections 148 and 302 read with 149 of the Indian Penal Code

evidence_type.correct_value: Eyewitness testimony (PW-10, PW-11); last-seen testimony (PW-6, PW-7); police investigation record
evidence_type.quote: We are not using the site plan to support the prosecution case or the case of the accused
evidence_type.reason: Court expressly disclaimed reliance on the site plan as evidence; it was used only to show unfair investigation.

confession.reason: No confession or admission by the accused is mentioned.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: No aggravating facts are noted in the judgment.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: No mitigating facts are noted in the judgment.

trial_court_outcome.correct_value: Convicted under ss.148 and 302 r/w 149 IPC; life imprisonment for murder, two years RI, fine Rs.25,000
trial_court_outcome.quote: Appellants were sentenced to undergo life imprisonment for the offence of murder and two years rigorous imprisonment
trial_court_outcome.reason: Matches the Sessions Court conviction and sentence described.

high_court_outcome.correct_value: Appeal dismissed; conviction and sentence upheld
high_court_outcome.quote: the High Court upheld the judgment of the Sessions Judge
high_court_outcome.reason: High Court upheld the trial court judgment.

final_outcome.quote: we allow the appeal, set aside the conviction of both the Courts below. Accused are acquitted accordingly.

fine_rs.reason: No final fine exists after acquittal.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Summary without stating that the witnesses named as signing the site plan denied signing; only one witness denied signing and the other denied going to the spot
neutral_facts.quote: Lakhan Singh states that he never went to the place of occurrence with the police and Ram Singh states that he never signed the site plan.
neutral_facts.reason: Facts say all named signatories denied signing; Lakhan denied going to the spot, not signing. Otherwise neutral and in range.

offence_severity.quote: life imprisonment for the offence of murder
offence_severity.reason: Null is not the required 'Not stated' format; judgment gives no statutory punishment range for s.302.

attempt_completion.reason: Death of the victim is alleged, so the offence is completed.

physical_harm.correct_value: Death of Gajraj Singh from beating with lathis, as alleged by prosecution
physical_harm.quote: Gajraj Singh was beaten to death by the five accused with lathis
physical_harm.reason: Matches prosecution case of death by lathi beating.

number_of_offences.reason: Two sections charged; none finally upheld after acquittal.

financial_property_loss.reason: No money or property loss is discussed.

premeditation_planning.reason: Court does not discuss premeditation or planning.

motive.correct_value: alleged: enmity between the two sides (court noted it could be the motive); alleged voting-related grievance (Meera)
motive.quote: It may be true that there was enmity between the two sides. Enmity... It can be the motive
motive.reason: Judgment discusses enmity as possible motive and a voting-related remark, so 'Not identified' is wrong.

key_evidence_accepted.correct_value: None relied on for conviction; eyewitness and last-seen evidence found doubtful
key_evidence_accepted.quote: a doubt has been cast and the benefit of doubt has to be given to the accused
key_evidence_accepted.reason: Court relied on none of the prosecution testimony for conviction.

witness_credibility.correct_value: PW-10 and PW-11 unreliable: prepared witnesses, contradictory, improving statements; PW-15 and PW-10 versions totally different
witness_credibility.quote: The versions of Har Bilas and that of Lakhan Singh (PW-10) are totally different.
witness_credibility.reason: Matches the court's credibility findings on these witnesses.

post_offence_conduct.reason: No accused post-offence conduct is described.

custody_duration.reason: Custody duration is not given; only bail status is mentioned.

bail_history.correct_value: Accused on bail; bail bonds discharged on acquittal
bail_history.quote: Accused are on bail. Their bail bonds are discharged.

trial_duration.correct_value: offence: 25.05.1994; trial judgment: 30.03.1995; High Court: 24.10.2008; Supreme Court: 24.10.2019
trial_duration.quote: judgment of the Sessions Judge, Datia dated 30.03.1995

legal_representation.correct_value: Accused: Ms. June Chaudhary, Sr. Adv., with others; Shikhil Suri as amicus. State: Rahul Kaushik and others
legal_representation.quote: Shikhil Suri, Adv. (A.C.) ... Advs. for the Appellants. Rahul Kaushik ... Advs. for the Respondent.

investigation_status.correct_value: FIR recorded after police visited the spot; site plan prepared; investigation found unfair
investigation_status.quote: The FIR has been recorded admittedly after visiting the spot by the police
investigation_status.reason: Matches the judgment's account of investigation.

procedural_irregularity.correct_value: Unfair investigation: site plan prepared on Lakhan Singh's instructions though he denied going to the spot and Ram Singh denied signing; Head Constable and SDOP not examined; important witnesses not examined
procedural_irregularity.quote: Lakhan Singh states that he never went to the place of occurrence with the police and Ram Singh states that he never signed the site plan.
procedural_irregularity.reason: Attributes both denials to one witness; Lakhan denied going, Ram denied signing.

appeal_history.correct_value: Trial court: convicted; High Court: appeal dismissed; Supreme Court: appeal allowed, acquitted
appeal_history.quote: the High Court upheld the judgment of the Sessions Judge
appeal_history.reason: Outcome at each level matches the judgment.

prosecution_argument.reason: The State's arguments before the Supreme Court are not recorded.

defence_argument.correct_value: PW-10 and PW-11 testimonies untrustworthy and contradictory; PW-6 and PW-7 contradictory and at best against Imrat Singh only
defence_argument.quote: at best the testimonies will go against Imrat Singh and not against any of the other accused
defence_argument.reason: Matches defence submissions recorded at paragraph 3.

legal_principle_applied.correct_value: Benefit of doubt to accused where contradictions, non-examination of witnesses and unfair investigation cast doubt
legal_principle_applied.quote: the benefit of doubt has to be given to the accused
legal_principle_applied.reason: Matches the principle applied by the court.

precedent_relied_upon.reason: No precedents are cited in the judgment.
